query:
SELECT
                            id           AS "id!: domain::RowID",
                            table_name,
                            row_id       AS "row_id!: domain::RowID",
                            field_name,
                            value,
                            hlc          AS "hlc!: domain::HybridLogicalClock",
                            client_id    AS "client_id!: domain::RowID",
                            version,
                            created_on   AS "created_on!: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>"
                        FROM change_sets
                        ORDER BY id ASC
                        LIMIT ?
